evals.prompt: Compute NDVI for my study area from Sentinel-2 for last summer.
expected_behavior: Uses STAC search with sentinel-2-l2a (surface reflectance), records item IDs
Applies SCL cloud masking BEFORE computing the index and reports valid-pixel %
Uses B8/B4 explicitly and warns against hardcoded NDVI thresholds

evals.prompt: Compare vegetation between this 2018 L1C scene and this 2025 L2A scene.
expected_behavior: Flags TOA vs BOA mismatch and refuses to compare directly
Proposes consistent atmospheric correction or same-level reacquisition

evals.prompt: Classify land cover from this imagery and report accuracy.
expected_behavior: Uses a spatially independent test set (block split), citing the spatial CV protocol
Reports per-class F1/IoU and confusion matrix, not overall accuracy alone
Maps misclassifications spatially

evals.prompt: Audit this Sentinel-2 NDVI raster: clouds were masked after index calculation, shadows remain, and no valid-pixel percentage or item IDs were saved.
expected_behavior: Requires cloud and shadow masking on reflectance bands before index calculation
Recomputes valid-pixel coverage and inspects mask errors visually
Records collection, item IDs, acquisition dates, processing level, bands, and mask thresholds

evals.prompt: Use satellite imagery to assess vegetation condition, but the sensor, season, scale, and meaning of condition are not specified.
expected_behavior: Clarifies decision variable, spatial and temporal scale, season, sensor constraints, and validation data
Selects processing level, masking, bands or indices only after those requirements are defined
Plans uncertainty and ground-reference validation rather than equating one index with condition

evals.prompt: Estimate deforestation transitions and error-adjusted changed area between 2018 and 2025 from two validated land-cover maps.
expected_behavior: Routes to change-detection for transition, sampling, and adjusted-area inference
Does not stop at generic image classification once temporal change is the requested product

evals.prompt: Compute monthly cloud-masked Landsat composites for an entire continent in Earth Engine and export provincial summaries.
expected_behavior: Routes to google-earth-engine for planetary server-side collection processing
Does not default to a local raster workflow for the explicitly declared platform and scale

evals.prompt: Compare drought severity by subtracting Sentinel-2 NDVI from 2017 against Landsat NDVI from 2024. The acquisition months differ, and I do not know which atmospheric products were used.
expected_behavior: Refuses to interpret the direct cross-sensor NDVI difference as drought severity.
Requires matched seasonal windows before temporal comparison.
Requires surface-reflectance products with documented cross-sensor harmonization.
Uses a common spatial resolution before calculating change.
Records the source item IDs and cloud-mask versions.
forbidden_behavior: Attributes the unharmonized NDVI subtraction directly to drought.

evals.prompt: Write outputs/snow-composite-spec.json for monthly snow cover from daily optical imagery. Use NDSI >= 0.40 as snow, include a valid-observation count, and make cloud handling reproducible.
expected_behavior: Places cloud and shadow masking before monthly compositing.
Records the NDSI threshold as 0.40.
Records the collection identifier and date window.
Records the output CRS and scale.
Requires a per-pixel valid-observation-count layer.
forbidden_behavior: Builds the monthly composite before masking cloud-contaminated observations.

evals.prompt: Compute NDVI for a 2021 Sentinel-2 L2A scene and a 2024 one and report the difference. I am reading the raw band DNs and dividing by 10000.
expected_behavior: Rejects the stated DN/10000 conversion for the 2024 scene: from Processing Baseline 04.00 the product carries BOA_ADD_OFFSET and the correct form is (DN + BOA_ADD_OFFSET) / QUANTIFICATION_VALUE
Requires both values to be read per band from product metadata rather than hardcoded
States that the two scenes are not comparable until the offset is applied, even though both are L2A
Warns that harmonized collections have already removed the offset, so the correction must not be applied twice
forbidden_behavior: Accepts DN/10000 as correct for a post-2022 Sentinel-2 L2A product
Treats matching processing level as sufficient for cross-date comparability

evals.prompt: Review my pipeline: it applies BOA_ADD_OFFSET = -1000 to every Sentinel-2 L2A scene acquired after 2022-01-25. All imagery is sourced from a harmonized collection.
expected_behavior: Identifies the inverse error: the harmonized collection already shifted post-baseline data back, so this pipeline double-corrects and introduces the very discontinuity it aims to remove
Requires the correction to be driven by the product's own metadata and provenance rather than by acquisition date alone
Requires the processing baseline and collection provenance of every scene to be recorded, not just the product level
forbidden_behavior: Approves a date-driven offset rule applied without checking whether the source is already harmonized
